name: mf-company-tax-rates-and-returns
description: French Saint-Martin corporate income tax (impot sur les societes) for 2026 under the collectivity's own tax code (CGI de la collectivite de Saint-Martin, consolidated to 5 June 2026). Covers territorial liability, the 20% ordinary rate, the 10% rate on the first 40,000 euros of profit for companies with turnover under 7,630,000 euros, fully paid capital and 75% qualifying ownership, short-period adjustment, rounding, the 10% long-term gains rate, ordinary losses, the return within three months of year end, the quarterly instalments and the balance, the unresolved instalment cross-reference, and the 2026 email-and-transfer filing channel. Applies to French Saint-Martin, not Dutch Sint Maarten. Trigger phrases include Saint-Martin corporate tax, impot sur les societes Saint-Martin, IS Saint-Martin 20%, taux reduit 10% Saint-Martin, acomptes IS Saint-Martin.
